name: LocalLLM Studio
tagline: Chat with local GGUF LLMs on your own machine — private, offline, model-agnostic.
description: Run open-weight language models (GGUF) fully offline on your own hardware via llama.cpp: a chat interface with system prompts, conversation history, adjustable sampling, and simple retrieval over your own files. You supply the model file — nothing is sent to any server.
